Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-demo: Evaluation commitments & trial gating for HelmBridge

Hi Alex + Priya — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed evaluation plan so we have a single place to confirm scope and owners. Attaching a compact outline (hb_poc_evaluation_outline.xlsx) with the same milestones.

Goal: validate Redwood Inference as the production inference layer for HelmBridge search + entity extraction workflows. We designed a 4-week trial to measure reliability, cost, and quality against your current stack.

Proposed high-level milestones
- Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): access & data handoff, API keys, sample dataset ingestion (you supply sample_data_spec.csv).
- Week 1 (integration & smoke): end-to-end pipeline working with 1k synthetic queries, basic monitoring in Console.
- Week 2 (quality validation): run our eval harness on your labeled set; target quality thresholds below.
- Week 3 (load & latency): scale tests to peak QPS, 95th pct latency targeting < 200ms for 1k tokens, and validate autoscaling behavior.
- Week 4 (acceptance): production-like canary (10% traffic) and final sign-off.

Success criteria (proposed — please review):
- Accuracy: entity extraction F1 >= 0.86 on your labeled set.
- Latency: 95th percentile < 200ms for representative requests, median < 60ms.
- Cost: projected inference unit cost <= $0.70 per 1k tokens under the target workload profile.
- Reliability: error rate < 0.5% during load window.
- Security: access via customer-managed VPC peering or dedicated Private deployment (decide on Week 0).

Redwood owners
- SE lead: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com) — integration + eval harness
- CS lead: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwoodinference.com) — success criteria & acceptance
- SRE contact (cc'd on follow-ups once environment is provisioned).

Immediate asks for HelmBridge
1) Confirm dataset delivery timeline and who will own labeling questions (format described in sample_data_spec.csv).
2) Confirm procurement path & PO timeline (so we can align reserved capacity if needed).
3) Decide whether you want Hosted trial or Private (VPC) in Week 0.
4) Share any additional success metric you want measured (e.g., top-K recall at K=5).

Attachments: hb_poc_evaluation_outline.xlsx, sample_data_spec.csv

If this looks good I’ll lock a kickoff for Mon Dec 14 (Week 0) and Ben will send a short access checklist.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — this is exactly the kind of tidy plan we need. A few quick items from our side:

Stakeholders from HelmBridge
- Priya Singh (Dir, Search) — product lead, decision-maker
- Alex Garner (engineering manager) — owner for integration
- Miguel Alvarez (sec/infra) — will own network/procurement questions

Data and labeling
- We can share an exported sample of 2k records by EOD Wed Dec 9. Miguel will also confirm the PII redaction status.

Acceptance metric nuance
- We like the F1 target but ask to add a recall floor (Recall@K=5 >= 0.78) — for our use case recall loss is costlier than precision. If Redwood can report that during Week 2 eval that would be ideal.

Security & procurement
- Miguel will reach out re: VPC peering vs Private, but procurement prefers Hosted initially for speed unless there’s a regulatory blocker.
- We usually need an MSA + SOW; can you share a short SOW template and SOC2 link?

Schedule
- Dec 14 kickoff works for us. Can Ben send a 30-min kickoff slot with a short checklist?

I’ll loop Miguel into the next thread; Priya — confirming you’re ok with the recall metric ask.

—Alex

Alex — appreciate the clarity. Quick operational notes from Redwood before kickoff:

Assigned resources
- SE lead (integration & eval): Ben Carter (me) — will own the eval harness and test scaffolding.
- CS lead (acceptance & rollout): Monica Patel (cc'd).
- SRE / infra liaison: Jordan Blake (I’ll introduce once we finalize Hosted vs Private).

Security/compliance links
- SOC2 report: https://redwoodinference.com/security/soc2 (we'll provide a redacted copy under NDA).
- Data retention & logs: we keep per-account request logs for 30 days in Hosted trials; Private can extend to customer-owned retention policies.

Technical clarifications
- Access model: if Hosted is preferred, we'll provide short-lived API keys and a pre-provisioned dev pool. For VPC/Private we need Miguel's CIDR & peering windows during Week 0.
- Eval harness: we'll run your labeled set + our stress tests. We can instrument Recall@K=5 and provide a per-query breakdown; we’ll log per-query tokens and compute inferred cost-to-1k for the sample workload.

Proposed kickoff & gating
- Kickoff: Mon Dec 14, 10:00–10:30 PT (Ben + Hannah + Monica + Alex + Miguel) — tentative calendar invite attached.
- Gate: after Week 2 quality eval we’ll jointly decide to proceed to load testing. Acceptance requires the agreed F1 + Recall@K thresholds and latency targets.

Attachments sent to this thread: hb_poc_evaluation_outline.xlsx (same as Hannah's), sample_data_spec.csv (format checklist). I also attached a short SOW template (SOW-template-4wks.pdf) for procurement.

Next steps for HelmBridge
1) Confirm whether Hosted trial is acceptable (saves provisioning time).
2) Share sample data export and Miguel's contact for peering if Private.
3) Approve the F1 + Recall acceptance wording; if you want we can tune threshold levels on a per-entity basis.
